subtitle: Hsien Fa Shan, Hsien Fa Hill · Xiyang Lou

questions.title: 海晏堂's east half and the plan's working names

evidence.title: Plates XVI to XIX: 观水法, 线法山门, 线法山, 螺蛳牌楼
evidence.excerpt_other: Montagne factice sur laquelle il y a un Ting-tsé,
evidence.summary: XVI throne facing the jets. XVII triumphal arch, the most Greek. XVIII an artificial hill with a 亭 on top. XIX another triumphal arch, less sober.

evidence.title: Engraving 18: 线法山 Xianfa Shan
evidence.excerpt_other: Regularly intersecting circular paths led up to the pavilion on the top of this circular hill,
evidence.summary: Circular hill, intersecting circular paths, pavilion on top. Lu says the emperor rode up on horseback. N.20: 线法 means line method, perhaps the Jesuits' perspective.

evidence.title: Engraving 17: 线法山门 Xianfa Shan gate
evidence.excerpt_other: A triple gateway, resembling a European triumphal arch.
evidence.summary: Triple gateway like a triumphal arch.

evidence.title: 万花阵 and 花园门; 线法山 and 螺蛳牌楼, yaffin 系列02, 13
evidence.summary: Lead: the maze gate 花园门 is shaped like a Western clock case with two brass doors; the maze 89 x 59 m, walls about 1.2 m high and over 1,600 m long; the hill 线法山 has a gate each side, the east one called 螺蛳牌楼. Check against the engravings.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.title: 西洋楼水法图
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
evidence.summary: Plan of the Xiyang Lou waterworks across its dozen sites; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.
